entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I received. I need to start a return, but I'm worried about the timing because of a personal situation that came up.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number? And just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the sensor or more of a preference issue?

The order is VF-77491. And no, it's not a fault. We had a sudden family emergency right after it arrived. My husband was rushed to the hospital and needed emergency surgery. It completely threw our week off.
Oh my, I am very sorry to hear that. I hope he is recovering well. Let me just pull up your order details with that number.

Thank you, he's stable now. It was just a lot to handle, especially with my son's upcoming military deployment. I know I missed the standard window, but I was hoping we could negotiate. I don't expect a full refund, but maybe a partial store credit would be possible?
I completely understand, and I appreciate you explaining the situation. Please give me one moment to review your order delivery date against our policy.
Okay, I see here that your VeloBand was delivered on January 12th of this year, which was five days ago.
Yes, exactly. And with everything that happened at the hospital, I feel like I'm already too late to do a simple return.

Actually, there's good news. You don't need any special exception. Our company policy allows for returns on all our products for up to 10 days after delivery. You are unfortunately outside that timeframe for a full refund.
Really? Ninety days? I had it in my head it was much shorter. Well, that's a huge relief. So there's no issue at all?
No issue at all. Your return is approved. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just place the item back in its box, apply the label, and you can drop it off at the post office.
That's fantastic. Thank you so much, Diana. You've made a very stressful situation much simpler.
I'm very happy I could help. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your family all the best.
